subject: Re: NovaLogic onboarding — runtime fit & token plan
messages:
From: Aditi Khanna <aditi.khanna@novalogic.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: NovaLogic kickoff + traffic snapshot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get started. I'm writing to share our initial traffic snapshot and a few clarifying questions before the formal kickoff. Attached is a small workbook (nova_kickoff_traffic.xlsx) with daily/weekly token estimates and some sample conversations. High level: 

- Use case: customer support summarization and next-step suggestions (multi-turn chat + documents).
- Average context length per session: ~1,200 tokens (prompt + history); occasional long-doc cases up to ~6,000 tokens.
- Estimated monthly token usage (year 1 conservative): 45,000,000 tokens.
- Expected peak: ~600,000 tokens / minute during campaign surges (short bursts, not sustained).
- SLA: 99.9% success rate; <500ms median latency target for short sessions, 1.5s for long-doc summarization acceptable.

Questions for your team before kickoff:
1) Do you recommend starting on Redwood Hosted or go straight to Dedicated?
2) Which model classes (13B chat-style vs 7B instruction) should we shortlist given the context variance?
3) Any immediate suggestions for caching / prefix strategies to blunt peak token spikes?

We'd like to schedule a 60-min technical handoff the week of Jan 18th (availability: Jan 18-20, mornings PST).

Thanks — attaching the workbook.

—Aditi
Aditi Khanna
Head of Product, NovaLogic
aditi.khanna@novalogic.com

Subject: Fwd: NovaLogic kickoff + traffic snapshot

Ben / Grace — forwarding NovaLogic's traffic snapshot. Key asks: avg session ~1.2k tokens, occasional 6k docs, monthly 45M, peak 600k tokens/min bursts. A few initial thoughts below; please add changes and we'll confirm ahead of the handoff meeting week of Jan 18.

Initial shortlist suggestions (fast-to-launch + tiered fallbacks):
- Candidate A: redwood-chat-13b-q8 (13B, chat-optimized, quantized) — good accuracy for multi-turn, handles 6k context with trimming but will need KV-cache tuning.
- Candidate B: mistral-instruct-7b (7B, instruction) — much cheaper, high throughput for shorter sessions (<=2k), consider for lower-priority routes.
- Candidate C: vicuna-14b-rlhf (14B-ish, conversational) — higher quality on summarization but heavier; use for premium customers or as canary.

Sizing & operational notes (rough):
- Monthly 45M tokens -> ~1.5M tokens/day average; good candidate for hosted during onboarding.
- Peak handling: 600k tokens/min -> ~10k tokens/sec. With avg 1.2k tokens/request that's ~8–9 rps at peak. That is within Hosted burst capacity but we should plan a short autoscale policy (burst to Dedicated-pool equivalent) if sustained >5min.
- Context strategies: enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts and KV cache reuse across identical sessions where possible; aggressive request-level batching for short sessions to reduce per-token overhead.

Immediate asks for handoff doc: can one of you draft a short model-profile PDF with estimated qps/latency vs cost curves for these three candidates? I'll confirm meeting times with Aditi.

-Olga

Aditi / Olga — attaching the requested model profiles (shortlist_model_profiles.pdf). Quick summary and ballpark economics below so you have something to react to before the tech handoff.

Shortlist rationale (condensed):
- redwood-chat-13b-q8: best balance for multi-turn summarization at medium latency. Handles ~6k effective context with KV cache; expected median latency for 1.2k requests ~350–600ms depending on batching.
- mistral-instruct-7b: cost-efficient for short sessions; median latency ~120–220ms; quality is very good for single-turn summarization but may need prompt engineering for multi-turn coherence.
- vicuna-14b-rlhf: strongest summarization fidelity on long docs, but ~2x cost of 13b; latency ~600–900ms. Reserve for high-priority paths.

Rough cost delta (hosted API estimate, per 1M tokens):
- redwood-chat-13b-q8: $28–35 / 1M tokens
- mistral-instruct-7b: $9–12 / 1M tokens
- vicuna-14b-rlhf: $55–70 / 1M tokens

Deployment recommendation for onboarding: start on Hosted (fast iteration + observability). For Dedicated planning, we should model a QPS profile and a 3-month runway; if NovaLogic expects sustained monthly >100M tokens or needs data isolation SLA, move to Dedicated.

Operational asks for Jan 18 handoff:
- Confirm which model(s) to canary in week 1.
- Finalize latency SLOs by route (chat vs long-doc).
- Provide any compliance/retention constraints (if storing user data).

Attachments: shortlist_model_profiles.pdf (model profiles, expected latency/cost curves).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

- Route B (premium): redwood-chat-13b-q8 for longer multi-turn sessions and document summarization.

We're not ready to commit to Dedicated yet; we'll revisit after we see actual traffic. Next steps:
1) Can you put together a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with high-level milestones (canary, performance review, go/no-go decision for Dedicated) and owners?
2) Schedule the technical handoff on Jan 19 at 10:00 AM PST if that still works for you (we can move if not).
3) We'll send any compliance constraints after the internal legal review (aiming EOD Jan 25).

Attaching a starter MAP for your review: MAP_NovaLogic_v1.docx

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
